scope: exploratory public 120x120 crops; not an official MeGlass benchmark or independent camera test

split.gallery_order: seeded shuffle of all six candidates, independent of condition
split.near_duplicate_cross_split: reject entire known identity at dHash Hamming distance <= 4

enrollment.identity_set_consistency: production validation on all six gallery images
enrollment.cross_identity_conflict: production enrollment in isolated temporary SQLite

primary_comparison.metric: test known correct identification / all known attempts
primary_comparison.safety_metric: test unknown false accepts / usable unknown faces, with Wilson interval

limitations: No trustworthy capture-session IDs; source photo IDs are not sessions.
dHash curation reads selected held-out image pixels, so this is not a fully sealed blind test.
The enrollment and near-duplicate gates select a nonrandom subset of identities.
Twenty unknown test identities cannot establish a low population FPIR.
Black eyeglasses do not represent every eyewear type, and crops do not represent live camera capture.
